title: MightyBuilding
description: A simple mod collection to streamline schematic creation.
body:
MightyBuilding is a mod collection designed for the creation of structures and saved as schematics; which can then be placed in other worlds and modpacks with tools like the Create mod schematic cannon. 

MightyBuilding gets its name and inspiration from the powerful mod, [The Mighty Architect](https://github.com/simibubi/TheMightyArchitect/wiki/Architects-Guide). Special thanks to simibubi (original creator) and TimStewartJ (ported it to NeoForge) for this mod. If you're not familiar with this mod I highly recommend you check it out. 

MightyBuilding also has a number of standard performance mods, building tools, and decorative block mods. The latter is limited mostly to some of the more popular mods to ensure any structures created remain compatible with other modpacks; but you should double check that your target modpack isn't missing any of the block mods in this modpack. If it is (or your target modpack has some mods this pack is missing) you can freely remove or add decorative block mods to this modpack without issue.

If you have feedback or want to report an issue, join my Discord: https://discord.gg/xQK57BxsRe
